name: pb-markdown-editor
description: A simple Markdown viewer and editor.

scripts.prestart: npm run prebuild-icon && npm run build:js
scripts.build:portable: npm run prebuild-icon && npm run build:js && electron-builder --win portable && npx rimraf dist/win-unpacked dist/*.yaml dist/*.yml dist/.icon-ico
scripts.build:installer: npm run prebuild-icon && npm run build:js && electron-builder --win nsis && npx rimraf dist/win-unpacked dist/*.yaml dist/*.yml dist/*.blockmap dist/.icon-ico
